alex: Quick PSA — onboarding Go sample-app + rerank pipeline is failing for a subset of customers, reproducer below :facepalm:
alex: Repro steps: 1) call embeddings.batch with 7 items, 2) call rerank with those vectors, 3) server returns mismatch error. Happens on go-sdk v0.4.2
alex: Code (Go):
```go
// simplified
reqs := [][]float32{...} // 7 vectors
resp, err := client.Embeddings.Batch(ctx, reqs)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
// send to reranker
rr, err := client.Rerank(ctx, resp.Vectors)
```
alex: Log snippet: 
"rerank: expected vector_len=1536 got=1535 for item 6"
alex: Takes down the sample-app during onboarding tests. Not all customers hit it — looks data/size dependent.
tasha: @alex fwiw saw a similar shape glitch in our rust sample a few weeks ago. It turned out to be the batching helper dropping a trailing zero when total_items % batch_size == 1 :eyes:
kevin: Which go-sdk version? any pinned transitive libs (jsoniter/encoding) that could change float->json serialization?
alex: go-sdk v0.4.2, standard encoding/json. No custom marshaler. Also noticed the embeddings response array length is correct but one vector is length 1535, not 1536.
olga: another theory: auth-retry path might be replaying a multipart/stream body that loses the final comma or newline and the server trims last float on parse. We had a similar retry bug where io.ReadCloser was not buffered and second attempt sent truncated body. :thinking_face:
sam: If retry loses the body bytes you'd typically see a 401 then 400. Do your logs show an auth refresh right before the bad batch?
alex: Yes — in a few traces I see 401 -> auth refresh -> identical request returns 200 but response contains one short vector.
kevin: Can you paste the raw request payload for a failing run? especially the end of the JSON array.
alex: pasted below (redacted):
```json
{"inputs":[[0.12,0.03,...,0.99],[...],[...],[...],[...],[...],[0.21,0.45,0.33,0.11]]}
```
alex: Note the final vector above looks truncated in the server logs (missing a trailing 0.0)
tasha: OK looks like two orthogonal issues: 1) batching helper edge-case for odd remainder, 2) retry/transport losing bytes on replay. Both can cause "short vector" symptoms.
sam: Quick workaround for onboarding: buffer the entire request in memory and use a bytes.Reader with io.ReadSeeker so retries send identical bytes. In Go: 
```go
b, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
req.Body = ioutil.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(b))
// on retry, reset reader: req.Body = ioutil.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(b))
```
sam: Also, validate len(vec) == expectedLen after embedding call and before rerank; if mismatch, surface a clear error to the user instead of silently sending bad data.
olga: I'll add a one-off check in the sample-app and open an MR to add that unit test for batch sizes 1..16 (especially when total%batchSize==1).
kevin: I'll triage the transport retry code. If RetryTransport consumes the body stream, we need to wrap it in bufio or use GetBody pattern (http.Request.GetBody).
alex: Thanks. Can someone open the bug? I'll paste link to trace and repro steps in the issue.
devex-bot: deploy: go-sdk v0.4.3 has been promoted to canary (includes tentative fix for retry body buffering) :rocket:
alex: Nice. Once canary lands I'll re-run onboarding harness. If stable we should backport to 0.4.x and add changelog note about batching + retry edge-case.
kevin: Filing issue now: RDW-ENG-7258 — includes trace, logs, and minimal repro. Assigning @olga for sample-app test and @kevin for transport fix.
olga: Got it, will add test and small fix for sample-app.
alex: Leaving this thread with a requested follow-up: add an integration test in our CI that runs the Go sample-app with batch sizes 1..20 and toggles auth refresh to exercise retry path. That should catch regressions early.
sam: +1. Also suggest adding an assertion in devex-qa harness that verifies every embedding has length == model_dim (1536) before calling rerank.
alex: Thanks everyone — I'll update the onboarding playbook with the workaround until the SDK fix is out. :thumbsup:
